Instax Mini SE Camera

Combo name- Joy Pack

Your ultimate companion for capturing and celebrating life’s most epic moments. Snap photos that instantly turn into keepsakes with film packs that keep your memories as vibrant as ever. Get ready to snap, share, and cherish your memories.

Capture the joy of instant photography with the Fujifilm Instax Mini SE Joy Pack.

Perfect for those who love preserving memories, this camera effortlessly blends nostalgia and creativity. Instantly snap, print, and hold your moments in your hands. Ideal for parties, events, and everyday adventures, it’s your ultimate tool for capturing and sharing memories on the spot.

Box Contents : 1 x Fujifilm Instax Mini SE , 2 x20 shots Instax mini glossy film, 1 x Instruction Manual, 1 x Warranty Card, 1 x Product Brochure
